cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.

mechanism: A copy-edits an apology so the subject and first sentence formally assign responsibility before regret is expressed.
confusable: D172 records agreement; D171 controls the form and sequence of an apology already being offered.
comparison: Written family blame correction differs from in-person apology before Dad.
seedUse: Keep vague sorry, vase and Mum's wrong belief; replace the detachable font joke with a direct subject/body edit.
